findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_screenshot_upload, get_screenshot_set · Private data: prepare_screenshot_upload, get_account, list_projects · Public sink: prepare_screenshot_upload, get_screenshot_set · Destructive: prepare_screenshot_upload, generate_screenshot_set.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_screenshot_upload, get_screenshot_set · Private data: prepare_screenshot_upload, get_account, list_projects · Public sink: prepare_screenshot_upload, get_screenshot_set · Destructive: prepare_screenshot_upload, generate_screenshot_set

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
